q2_gaps: an ACTIVE lexical deontic verb ("the Council permits an apprentice to V"; likewise authorizes / allows / forbids): the instruction set gives deontic routing only for modals and for the passive/participial "Ns are permitted / are required / are forbidden to V", so it never says whether the complement of an active permission verb with its own granting subject additionally carries `(Permitted e)`, or stays a plain object-control complement with no status of its own (as the control-verb rule's "no tense / status of its own" implies)
notes: "The Council" correctly takes no `Name` atom (capitalized bare kind-word label = common noun by default), and the object-control pattern (controller's role copied into the complement, object never on the matrix verb), the inception shape (`Theme` = activity witness + `Ongoing`), and the no-status-on-bare-simple-present rule are all applied as written. `(Manner sk_tend_1 solo)` for "solo tending" is a judgment call, but "solo" is a manner-proper adverbial rather than one of the barred duration / sequence / scope / degree classes.
